identity.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
identity.notes: 77 LFP/graphite 18650 cells; cycle ageing at 30 °C with per-cycle voltage-current-capacity frames and the authors' RUL labels; Ma et al. Energy & Environmental Science 2022

conditions.protocol_charge_raw: CC 5C from 0 to 80% SOC, CC 1C from 80% SOC to 3.6 V, then CV at 3.6 V until the current falls to C/20; identical for all cells
conditions.protocol_discharge_raw: four CC steps per cell: 100-60% SOC, 60-40%, 40-20% and 20-0% SOC, the last at 1C to a 2 V cutoff; 77 different combinations (e.g. 5C-4C-3C-1C); 30 s rest between steps; 1C = 1.1 A

content.cycle_basis: number of per-cycle DataFrames in the pickle's `data` dict
content.count_basis: 77 LFP/graphite cells per the Mendeley v2 description; 146,122 per-cycle curve files.

quality.notes: Per-cycle voltage-current-capacity DataFrames with the authors' RUL and dq; no temperature channel. Current is in mA and capacity in mAh (from the column names). Voltage cutoffs and manufacturer are not stated on the landing page, so voltage_min_V/voltage_max_V stay null (not inferred from the matching 1.1 Ah/3.3 V A123 spec). Charge/discharge rate estimates, where explicitly marked raw_data in the citations, use signed observed current extrema divided by the stored nominal Ah. These are measurement estimates over the cached extraction scope, not imposed CC protocol setpoints; they may include pulse, dynamic, regenerative or diagnostic segments and measurement excursions. Current units and direction were checked against the cited original headers, status labels or separate charge/discharge counters. cached extraction covers all 77 recognised pickle cell records; both maximum values were independently located in their original per-cycle DataFrames. The observed maxima are approximately 5C with small measurement variations; the exact protocol setpoint is not inferred by rounding them to 5C. Charging profile: the charge is the same CC-CV for every cell; the C-rate differs between cells through the multi-stage discharge. Primary paper: Ma et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 2022, 15, 4083 (10.1039/d2ee01676a), read in full: cells are A123 APR18650M1A LFP/graphite; Neware CT-4008 tester at 30 °C; 80 cells were cycled and 3 excluded for sudden faults, leaving 77; cycling ended when capacity first reached 80% of nominal; cycle lives 1100-2700 (146122 cycles in total); 55 training and 22 testing cells. Voltage limits 2.0 and 3.6 V are the paper's discharge cutoff and charge CC cutoff. Discharge step currents per cell are in the paper's ESI Table S1, which was not supplied. The paper's 5C charge and 5C first discharge stage agree with the observed 5.0C maxima. ESI (supplied, saved with the paper): Table S1 lists the 77 cells as protocols #1-#77 with test channel (1-1 to 10-8; channels 2-1, 6-7 and others are absent), train/test role (55 train, 22 test) and cycle life 1,142-2,689 cycles, and the four discharge rates C1-C4: C1 (100-60% SOC) 2-5C, C2 (60-40%) 1-5C, C3 (40-20%) 1-5C, C4 (20% SOC to 2 V) always 1C; the maximum discharge rate is therefore 5C, which agrees with the observed 5.0C maximum. Fig. S2 confirms the shared charge as 5C to 80% SOC, then 1C to the first 3.6 V, then CV at 3.6 V until C/20. Fig. S1: 80-channel Neware tester and two thermostatic chambers. Cell-level protocol labels from Table S1 were not added to the per-cell records.
